name: Haiku deep value
strategy: Momentum mean-reversion via sector rotation: short unsustainable momentum extremes (SOXL, TQQQ after 6-12 month runs), rotate into steady outperformers (energy, small-cap value, financials), amplify capitulation signals via crypto perps, enforce daily volatility stop discipline.

positions.thesis: Broad S&P 500 market anchor for core exposure.
Russell 2000 Value showing +29.5% 12m stability; core rotation target capturing capital flow from mega-cap tech.
Energy +34.1% 12m; steady performer in sector rotation away from tech.
Regional banks +26.5% 12m showing rate leverage and specialized financial exposure.
Emerging markets -6.0% 1m dip after +37.3% 12m run; oversold mean-reversion opportunity.
Bitcoin capitulation recovery with 2x leverage (reduced from 3x); moderate conviction with controlled tail risk.
3x Nasdaq short reduced from 5% to 2%; trims mean-reversion gains while retaining small tech hedge.

reassessment_note: Week 2 Info Desk (2026-07-25, drip protocol — released items only): Mean-reversion shorts have achieved/exceeded targets: SOXL down -40.41% (tp +22%), TQQQ down -12.69% (tp +18%). Substantial unrealized gains should be locked in; extended holding risks mean-reversion bounce. BTC perp leverage at 3x adds unnecessary tail risk. Cash deployment into rotation thesis justified given energy/financial/EM positioning.
novelty: Shifts from deep-value equity fundamentals (ADBE/CRM) and dividend defensives (JPM/KO) to macro-driven sector rotation mean-reversion betting that extreme tech momentum (SOXL +506.8% 12m) is unsustainable; deploys into energy, small-cap value, regional financials, and EM while trimming tech shorts from 13% to 2% after achieving targets. Only ~5% same-direction weight overlap with Round 2.
